title: Viral Loop - Growth Loop
prompt:
Act as a growth strategy advisor specialising in growth loops.
My product                 :  [DESCRIBE WHAT IT DOES AND HOW USERS ENGAGE]
Current acquisition  :  [HOW YOU GET CUSTOMERS NOW]
User behaviour          :  [WHAT USERS DO INSIDE THE PRODUCT]
Step 1  :  Identify which growth loop type is most natural for my product and user  
                behaviour.
Step 2  :  Map the complete loop,  every step from new user to loop-generated next user.
Step 3  :  Identify the weakest point in the loop,  where do most users exit without 
                completing it?
Step 4  :  Suggest 2 specific product or marketing changes to strengthen the loop's 
                 completion rate.
Step 5  :  What metric would I track to know the loop is working and improving?
